text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! I have no idea what I should 
eat...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I gained that much 
weight... Should I just eat seaweed for my 
side dish? Or should I just skip meals 
altogether...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, before as well...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Espo! There's no way that tiny bit 
of rice and seaweed is enough nutrition! 
Put a little more thought into your 
weight-loss menu!"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"‘If there's something you can't do, first 
admit your own clumsiness. ...That's why 
you're weak.’"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"—Tch, shut up, shut up! Don't go bossing 
me around, you old bastard!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...! Just thinking about it is 
pissing me off...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't look down on me! Even I can pull 
off a well-behaved, proper weight cut!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Compared to white rice, brown rice digests 
more slowly, so it keeps you feeling full 
longer... Hmph, I see!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
100g of chicken breast is roughly 130 
calories, and an egg is about 80 calories. 
Which means, the other ingredients I'm 
allowed to eat are—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Sautéed chicken breast, brown rice, boiled 
egg, broccoli... Hell yeah! It's done, 
dammit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, even on my own, something like this 
is a piece of cake! ...How's that, you old 
bastard?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's amazing! This is practically 
a full-course diet meal! Did someone teach 
you this, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haah!? Don't mess with me! I don't 
need guidance from anyone! Hmph!

"...Afterward, Espoir City stuck firmly to 
a healthy diet, and successfully managed 
to slim down."
